text: What people do is usually a reflection of who they are, not a definition of who we are.
Choose the person over the problem.
Enter a conversation with something to learn, rather than something to prove.
Some blessings come as things. Some come as moments. Some come as people.
People rarely remember the face that impressed them the most. They remember the heart that gave them peace.
Words can last for a very, very long time.
Someone leaving doesn’t mean you weren’t enough.
